item.title: Insights from AusBiotech 2019 and Pharmaceutical Machinery Innovations
item.description:
Insights from AusBiotech 2019 and Pharmaceutical Machinery Innovations
#

Every year, AusBiotech serves as a pivotal gathering point for leaders and stakeholders in the Australian and international biotechnology sectors. The 2019 conference, held in Melbourne from October 30 to November 1 at the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre (MCEC), provided three days dedicated to education, skill development, and networking. This event is recognized for fostering reflection on industry achievements and facilitating the exchange of ideas to propel the sector forward both nationally and globally.

item.title: Comprehensive Overview of Capsule Filling and Pharmaceutical Processing Equipment
item.description:
Capsule Filling Solutions for Efficient Pharmaceutical Production
#

Pharmaceutical encapsulation equipment, commonly known as capsule filling machines, plays a crucial role in the manufacturing process of capsules. These machines are designed to efficiently fill powders, granules, or liquid substances containing nutrients into empty capsules of various sizes. Their application extends across industrial and pharmaceutical sectors, where reliability, efficiency, and ease of operation are essential.

item.title: Comprehensive Overview of Semi-Automatic Capsule Filling Solutions
item.description:
Exploring Semi-Automatic Capsule Filling for Pharmaceutical Production
#

The SCF-10 semi-automatic capsule filling machine offers a practical solution for pharmaceutical manufacturers seeking a balance between manual and automated capsule production. Designed for simplicity and compliance with hygiene standards, the SCF-10 is capable of producing up to 12,000 capsules per hour, making it suitable for small to medium batch operations.
